name: ECA Entity Print
description: ECA actions to print an entity or View to a PDF/document file and save it as a file entity.
project_description:
ECA action plugins to print file document from a chosen entity or a view and saves it as a file entity.

 Additional Requirements 
 You will need to have ECA , Entity Print modules installed and configured.

 Recommended modules 
 
 BPMN.iO : JavaScript-based implementation for building models as two-dimensional diagrams, integrated into the Drupal admin UI 
 Camunda : user-friendly desktop client for designing and deploying automated processes 
 ECA Classic Modeller : "low-level" modelling tool using Drupal core's form API
